calls.expect: a domain name such as example.com

not_smoked.search_abuseipdb: needs an AbuseIPDB API key (ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY), which CI does not have
not_smoked.search_ip2location: needs an IP2Location.io API key (IP2LOCATION_API_KEY), which CI does not have
not_smoked.search_dorks_live: needs a Bright Data SERP API key (BRIGHTDATA_API_KEY); each of its five queries is billed
not_smoked.search_footprint: needs a Bright Data SERP API key (BRIGHTDATA_API_KEY); each query is billed
not_smoked.search_gdelt_geo: downloads up to six hours of GDELT news archives (tens of MB) per run and answers with the day's news: neither small nor deterministic enough for a smoke run
not_smoked.search_paste: psbdmp.ws, a free paste index, is often unreachable: a run would fail on its outage, not on this server
